cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Move It for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to rearrange an ordinary commitment as proof that your relationship takes priority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Move your haircut so we can have lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. We've been friends since school. Couldn't I have its place just once?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They charge twenty pounds if I change it today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll pay. Put lunch in that exact slot, in pen. You've used pencil for me since school.

mechanism: A uses supposedly expert diary-priority rules to make B replace a haircut with lunch as visible proof their long friendship ranks first.
confusable: D22 would trade favors for value; here paying the fee is only a way to secure the exact rescheduling that demonstrates relationship priority.
comparison: Exhibition alternative requires publicly naming a family priority; lunch alternative requires giving A an established appointment slot.
seedUse: Haircut, school friendship and change fee derive from D35-a; S03 adds distinction between booking age and importance as A corrective scheduling method.
